item.title: Hear why the bicycle workshop changed
item.summary: A workshop organiser explains what learners can still do when a delivery is late.
item.transcript_text:
Tutor: We start with brakes rather than tyres this week. The delivery of inner tubes has been put back to Thursday.
Learner: Do I need to bring my bike tonight, then?
Tutor: Please do. We can check the brakes on your bike. If a cable needs replacing, put a paper label on the handlebar. Anyone who wants to work on a flat tyre can use a spare wheel for practice, but we won't fit new tubes tonight.
Learner: Should I bring the label back next week?
Tutor: Leave it on the bike until we have checked the cable. We'll take it off when the job is done.

questions.prompt: Why has the first activity changed?
options: The tutor forgot the brake tools
No learners can bring a bike
A delivery will arrive later than planned
The workshop is closing on Thursday
questions.explanation: The inner tubes have been delayed.

options: Their own inner tubes
Their own bicycles
Their own spare wheels
Their own cables
questions.explanation: The tutor asks learners to bring their bikes for brake checks.

questions.prompt: When should a paper label be attached?
options: When a cable needs changing
When a tyre has been replaced
When a bicycle arrives late
When a learner uses the spare wheel
questions.explanation: A label identifies work still needed on a cable.

questions.prompt: How can a learner practise dealing with a flat tyre tonight?
options: By taking a tube from the delivery
By fitting a new tube to their bike
By returning on Thursday evening
By using a spare wheel
questions.explanation: A spare wheel is available, although new tubes will not be fitted tonight.

options: The learner before the bicycle is checked
The delivery driver
The workshop team after checking the cable
The learner at the start of next week
questions.explanation: The tutor says the team takes it off after the job.
